item.title: Charter captains updated on Lake Erie topics, issues
item.description: On Saturday, March 7, about 140 people gathered to share and hear news and updates about operating vessels and fishing in Lake Erie at Ohio Sea Grant’s 45th annual charter captains conference at Bowling Green State University’s Firelands campus in Huron. The March 7 date fell in between ice fishing and boating seasons this year, and thanks to a grant that allowed a reduction of the registration price, attendance climbed after drawing less than 100 participants last year. item.title: Pennsylvania’s Old Crow Wetland being degraded in Huntingdon County
item.description: Although there was some activity at the Rutter’s construction site in Smithfield Township near Huntingdon during the winter, all construction work stopped at the end of September. Heavy equipment has been removed from the site by the contractor. At this point, there has been much earth movement and the construction of a large retaining wall on the downslope sides of the property. item.title: Mallard in Pennsylvania’s Blair County displays both male and female traits
item.description: A mallard observed this winter in central Pennsylvania sparked discussion among birders and waterfowl hunters after appearing to display traits of both sexes. Gliding across the water alongside a flock of mallards and an American black duck, the bird was initially dismissed by some observers as a possible hybrid. item.title: Ohio Sea Grant deploys robots for lake cleanup
item.description: Ohio Sea Grant recently completed another successful season deploying its trash-trapping robots – BeBot and PixieDrone – through partnerships with the Great Lakes Plastic Cleanup (GLPC) and funding and support provided by Midwest retailer Meijer. item.title: 80,000 rainbow trout to be stocked across Ohio
item.description: The Ohio DNR (ODNR) Division of Wildlife will release more than 80,000 rainbow trout at 93 locations beginning in March. The locations were chosen to give as many anglers as possible a chance to reel in these feisty fish in March, April, and May. Trout releases are designed for high angler success and harvest, according to the Division of Wildlife. The post 80,000 rainbow trout to be stocked across Ohio appeared first on Outdoor News.

item.title: Retired NFL player to host second ‘Buckeye Blast’ in Ohio to help young outdoors people
item.description: The Buckeye Blast is back after a successful inaugural year. The Light Foundation, co-founded by New England Patriots Hall of Famer and three-time Super Bowl champion Matt Light, will host its second annual fundraising event, The Buckeye Blast, on May 12, at Delaware, Ohio’s five-star Black Wing Shooting Center. item.title: So-called ‘trash birds’ show alarming decline in U.S.
item.description: Billions fewer birds are flying through North American skies than decades ago and their population is shrinking ever faster, mostly due to a combination of intensive agriculture and warming temperatures, a new study found.
